notes: Generated 26 test methods covering all confirmed intents for story SQL-LS-001-007. Tests follow NUnit 3.14.0 conventions with Moq 4.20.72 for mocking. All tests use AAA pattern with Assert.Multiple for multiple property assertions. Domain tests cover entity constructor validation (valid/invalid types, zero/negative dimensions, null/empty values). Application tests cover service creation and exception propagation. Infrastructure tests cover repository AddAsync with in-memory database and mocking. Presentation tests cover handler responses (201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 500 Internal Server Error).
